urdu: وزیر خان نے کس سال میں مسجد کی بنیاد رکھی؟
english: In which year did Wazir Khan lay the foundation of the mosque?
roman_1: Wazir Khan ne kis saal mein masjid ki buniyad rakhi?
roman_2: Wazir Khan nay kis saal main masjid ki buniyad rakhi?
roman_3: Wazir Khan ne kis saal may masjid ki buniyad rakhi?
